attempts.summary: Created an SSH CA on node1 (/etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca), signed the ed25519 host key into /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub with principals node1/NODE_IP/localhost, configured sshd via HostCertificate, and verified a client trusting only an @cert-authority line (no pinned host key) connects successfully while a client with no CA trust is rejected. Completed mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id baseline, rebooted via `shutdown -r now`, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified sshd active plus CA-trusted SSH connection worked post-reboot.
